title: Sniff
desc: An anosmic boy gains super smell powers and uses them to fight crime, turning into a pint-sized superhero with humor and noble purpose.

title: Love Hostel
desc: A bold young couple in rustic North India races from a ruthless mercenary, facing danger and desire as their love is tested in a tense, thrilling chase.

title: Trapped
desc: A man becomes trapped inside a bare, empty high-rise with no food, water, or power, forcing him to endure isolation, scarcity, and relentless uncertainty.

title: English vinglish
desc: Housewife And Caterer Shashi Is Usually Mocked By Her Family For Not Knowing English. Her Attempt To Learn The Language Helps Her Rediscover Herself And Reassert Her Value As A Mother And A Wife.

title: I Want To Talk
desc: Arjun loves to talk and lives the 'American Dream'-until he learns he has only 100 days left! Now, he wants just 2 things: to spend his remaining time with his 7-year-old estranged daughter.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das leads India's hockey team post-independence, facing numerous challenges as he fights to bring home Olympic gold and uplift national pride through sport.

title: O Romeo
desc: In Post-Independence Mumbai, The Underworld Rises Amidst A Changing City. This Gritty Tale Explores The Criminal Landscape Of A Bygone Era, Weaving Through The Streets And Shadows Of India'S Bustling Metropolis.

title: Naam Shabana
desc: A young woman joins a secret intelligence unit to seek justice for her friend's murder, transforming into a fierce agent with purpose and skill.

title: Paltan
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Raj Singh Yadav and his soldiers protect the Nathu La Pass from the Chinese while coping with the pain of being separated from their loved ones.

title: Do Lafzon Ki Kahani
desc: A boxer's relationship with a visually impaired girl is challenged when they discover each other's past.

title: Mad
desc: Manoj, Ashok, and Damodar form the unbreakable MAD squad, navigating hilarious hijinks, budding romances, and deep lifelong friendships during their transformative and chaotic college years together.

title: Heartless
desc: During A Heart Transplant Surgery, Aditya Experiences Anaesthesia Awareness And Finds Out That His Doctor Dr Sameer Saxena And His Wife Ria Have Hatched A Plot To Kill Him.

title: Poorna
desc: Poorna Malavath, a tribal teen, is selected for Operation Everest. At just 13, she climbs Mount Everest, becoming the youngest girl to reach the summit.

title: Turtle
desc: In a drought-struck village in Rajasthan, Ramkaran Choudhary churns the parched earth to extract water while the villagers indulge in a tug of war in desperation as they seek to quench their thirst.

title: Uunchai
desc: Retired friends trek to Everest, fulfil a dying friend's wish, find true life.

title: Madgaon Express
desc: Dodo, Piku, and Aayush finally plan their long-awaited Goa trip, but chaos ensues with a drug bag mix-up and gangsters chasing them-making their dream adventure a wild nightmare!

title: Kites
desc: A wounded man searches for his sweetheart in the Mexican desert while on the run from the police, bounty hunters, and others.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: Shalini, once a naive nursing student from Kerala, recounts her tragic journey as she becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifying how innocence led her into the shadows of extremism.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, seeks help from DK, a private detective, and vows to get revenge after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted by the court.

title: Yeh Saali Aashiqui
desc: Love becomes deadly when betrayal sparks obsession, dragging two lives into a dangerous spiral of revenge, manipulation, and the high price of passion gone wrong.

title: Khamoshiyan
desc: Kabir, a struggling writer, travels to Kashmir for inspiration and starts staying at a mysterious guest house. He falls in love with Meera, the owner of the guesthouse, who harbours a dark secret.

title: Tumsa Nahi Dekha
desc: Daksh, a millionaire who is always drunk, sees Jia, a stripper, on a street and falls madly in love with her. However, if he does not marry Anahita, he stands to lose his inheritance.

title: Nanu Ki Jaanu
desc: Nanu, A Land Mafia Agent, Tries To Rescue A Woman Who Met With An Accident. The Woman, However, Dies But Her Ghost Arrives In Nanu'S Apartment.

title: Kaanchi
desc: Kaanchi, a fearless young woman, witnesses her lover's murder by a powerful politician's son. Fleeing her village, she embarks on a determined quest for justice and revenge.
